description: Prospective extension of the frozen cross-model filtering protocol, with Qwen3-8B positive control. No outcome-dependent model, layer, strength or eligibility tuning.
clean_eligibility: Native raw continuation, source-correct, target-incorrect; single-token source and target; concept <=40 units per type balanced over source entities. Frozen before edits.
contrasts: latent full vs off_m at each fixed strength
concept lam1_cn vs lam0_cn, within-unit query means
uncertainty: Paired 95% source-entity cluster bootstrap, 2000 fixed-seed draws, conditional on one lens fit. Pointwise intervals, no multiplicity correction.
interpretation: Assess both relational success and incorrect name emission. Report every completed model and every failure; no model selected by edited outcomes. Fresh positive-control replay checks pipeline behavior; differing eligibility prevents exact paper-rate comparison.
scope_limits: One GSM8K fit per model; no WikiText or fit-seed replication.
Fixed seven-layer relative grid; no model-specific workspace calibration.
Raw continuation prompts; no chat templates.
Limited to latent-intermediate and concept express/use tasks, not the entire paper.
